title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail that glides across a tank of moonlit teal water, trailing a ribbon of glowing plankton as it twirls between drifting kelp and a half-buried brass music box. Every few turns it pauses, tips its shell like a hat, and releases a tiny chime of bubbles. The tank is a quiet ballroom, and the whelk is its only guest.
